_comment: THE ONE-TIME CARRY (CARD1-S3, v1.304.0): per deck, the old key of each card v1.182.2 reworded and its card's key today, 16 hex characters a pair (old 8, new 8). GENERATED by scripts/build_card_carry.py from the three emits named in `commits`; never hand-edited. The neural emitter checks every pair against the decks it emits and ships the kept ones as data chunks (carry/<i>.json); neural/src/card-carry.src.js carries a record's rows once.
